questions.question:
Which of the following letters will replace the question mark (?) and complete the following letter series?

D, B, X, R, J, ?
questions.solution:
The positional values of English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/639fa2993810fb6a6846e15a62ff1eb6d72250736d8140eb6d6dcda2f97302c1.png] 

D - 2 = B

B - 4 = X {Alphabet series end with Z = 26. If we take 4 steps back, then it will be X.} 

X - 6 = R

R - 8 = J

J - 10 = Z 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Z".**
